scanNote:
Photo File Section, UNIT 14 varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

⚠ Bu — RASMLI XAT (135 va 139-betlardagi kabi), lekin MUHIM YANGILIK bor: har bir rasmning yonida QIZIL BELGI turadi:

  ✓ (yashil/qizil belgi) = BUNI QILING
  ✗ (qizil xoch)         = BUNI QILMANG

⚠ Ya'ni rasm faqat SO'Zni emas, MASLAHATNING TURINI ham ko'rsatadi. ✓ bo'lsa 'should', ✗ bo'lsa 'shouldn't' yoziladi.

Xat: Klara xola jiyani Stivga sog'lom turmush tarzi haqida maslahat beradi.

Yuqori o'ng burchakda jo'natuvchi manzili:
  12, Apple Street
  Plymouth
  PL7 6TQ
  6 May, ...........

⚠ Sanadagi bo'sh joy — YIL uchun (o'quvchi to'ldiradi).

Oxirida: 'I hope my advice will help you. Good luck!' va 'Love, Aunt Claire'.

⚠ 'PL7 6TQ' — Britaniya pochta indeksi (postcode). 'PL' — Plymouth shahrining kodi.

⚠ Unitlar tartibi: 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 5, 6, 8, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14.

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 14: A letter of advice from Aunt Claire

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 14 - Look at the pictures and the ✓ / ✗ marks, then complete the letter.
exercises.instructionUz: 14-UNIT — Rasmlarga va ✓ / ✗ belgilariga qarang, so'ng xatni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — MASLAHAT XATI.

  Klara xola jiyani Stivga sog'lom
  turmush tarzi haqida maslahat beradi.


⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM YANGILIK — BELGILAR:

  Har rasmning yonida belgi turadi:

     ✓  = BUNI QILING
           → 'should' / 'It's better to'

     ✗  = BUNI QILMANG
           → 'shouldn't' /
             'It isn't a good idea to'

  ⚠ Ya'ni rasm faqat SO'Zni emas,
  MASLAhATNING TURINI ham ko'rsatadi!

  ⚠ 135-betdagi Paulaning xatida bunday
  belgilar yo'q edi — u yerda faqat so'z
  yozilardi.


BELGILAR RO'YXATI:

  ✓  meva-sabzavot, donli nonushta, sut,
     suv, mashq, piyoda yurish

  ✗  pitsa, gamburger, kola, limonad,
     shokolad, tort


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

──────────────────────────────────
              12, Apple Street
              Plymouth
              PL7 6TQ
              6 May, ..........

  Dear Steve,

  Thank you for your letter. I am
  happy to hear that you want to
  change your bad habits.

  There are a lot of things you can
  do to keep fit and healthy.

  Firstly, you SHOULD EAT MORE FRUIT
  AND VEGETABLES. You SHOULDN'T EAT
  PIZZA or HAMBURGERS. They aren't
  healthy at all.

  It's BETTER TO HAVE CEREAL and MILK
  for breakfast. They will give you a
  good start to the day.

  You SHOULDN'T DRINK COLA or
  LEMONADE because they are full of
  sugar. Why DON'T YOU DRINK WATER
  instead?

  Also, it ISN'T A GOOD IDEA TO EAT
  CHOCOLATES or CAKES. You will only
  get fat.

  You SHOULD DO MORE EXERCISE. Why
  don't you leave the car at home and
  WALK to work?

  I hope my advice will help you.
  Good luck!

              Love,
              Aunt Claire
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'Aziz Stiv,

   Xatingiz uchun rahmat. Yomon
   odatlaringizni o'zgartirmoqchi
   ekaningizni eshitib xursand bo'ldim.

   Sog'lom va tetik bo'lish uchun
   qilishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'p narsa
   bor.

   Birinchidan, ko'proq meva va sabzavot
   yeyishingiz kerak. Pitsa yoki gamburger
   yemasligingiz kerak. Ular umuman
   foydali emas.

   Nonushtaga donli nonushta va sut
   iste'mol qilgan yaxshiroq. Ular sizga
   kunni yaxshi boshlash imkonini beradi.

   Kola yoki limonad ichmasligingiz kerak,
   chunki ularda shakar juda ko'p. Buning
   o'rniga suv ichsangiz-chi?

   Yana, shokolad yoki tort yeyish yaxshi
   fikr emas. Siz faqat semirasiz.

   Ko'proq jismoniy mashq qilishingiz
   kerak. Mashinani uyda qoldirib, ishga
   piyoda borsangiz-chi?

   Maslahatim sizga yordam berishiga umid
   qilaman. Omad!

              Mehr bilan,
              Klara xola'


⚠⚠ 14-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI — 'SHOULD':

  QOLIP:
     SHOULD + fe'l (asosiy shakl)

     'You SHOULD EAT more fruit.'
     'You SHOULDN'T DRINK cola.'

  ⚠ 'should' HECh QAChON o'zgarmaydi:
     I should, he should, she should
     ('he shouldS' ✗)

  ⚠ 'should' dan keyin:
     • 'TO' YO'Q:  'should to eat' ✗
     • '-S' YO'Q:  'should eats'  ✗

  INKOR:
     should not → SHOULDN'T

  SAVOL:
     'SHOULD I eat more fruit?'
     ⚠ 'should' oldinga chiqadi.

  ⚠ MA'NOSI: maslahat, tavsiya
  ('kerak', 'yaxshi bo'lardi')

  ⚠ 'must' dan FARQI:
     'should' — MASLAHAT (yumshoq)
     'must'   — MAJBURIYAT (qattiq)


⚠ MASLAHAT BERISHNING 4 USULI:

  Xatda TO'RTTASI ham ishlatilgan:

  1) SHOULD / SHOULDN'T
     'You should eat more fruit.'

  2) IT'S BETTER TO ...
     'It's better to have cereal.'

  3) IT ISN'T A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'It isn't a good idea to eat cakes.'

  4) WHY DON'T YOU ...?
     'Why don't you drink water?'

  ⚠ 4-usul — SAVOL shaklidagi maslahat,
  eng muloyimi.

  ⚠ 'Why don't you' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda: 'Why don't you DRINK' ✓
  ('to drink' ✗)


⚠ 'NOT ... AT ALL':

  'They aren't healthy AT ALL.'
     = Ular UMUMAN foydali emas.

  'at all' inkorni KUChAYTIRADI.


⚠ 'INSTEAD' — O'RNIGA:

  'Why don't you drink water INSTEAD?'
     = Buning o'rniga suv ichsangiz-chi?

  ⚠ 'instead' gap OXIRIDA turadi
  (yolg'iz ishlatilganda).

  ⚠ 'instead OF' + ot/fe'l+ing:
     'instead of cola'
     'instead of drinking cola'


⚠ BRITANIYA XAT MANZILI:

     12, Apple Street   ← uy raqami, ko'cha
     Plymouth           ← shahar
     PL7 6TQ            ← pochta indeksi
     6 May, ......      ← sana (yil bo'sh)

  ⚠ 'PL7 6TQ' — Britaniya POSTCODE'i.
  'PL' — Plymouth shahrining kodi.

  ⚠ Britaniyada manzil KIChIKDAN KATTAGA
  yoziladi: uy → ko'cha → shahar → indeks.

  ⚠ Manzil xatning O'NG YUQORI burchagida
  turadi.

  ⚠ Sanadagi bo'sh joy — YIL uchun.


⚠ 'ADVICE' — SANALMAYDI!

     'my advice'      ✓
     'some advice'    ✓
     'an advice'      ✗
     'advices'        ✗

  ⚠ Bitta maslahat: 'a PIECE of advice'

  ⚠ 'to advise' (FE'L) — 's' bilan;
     'advice' (OT) — 'c' bilan!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  advice      = maslahat (sanalmaydi)
  to advise   = maslahat bermoq
  a habit     = odat
  bad habits  = yomon odatlar
  to keep fit = tetik yurmoq
  healthy     = sog'lom, foydali
  fit         = tetik, sportchan
  sugar       = shakar
  full of     = ... ga to'la
  instead     = buning o'rniga
  to get fat  = semirmoq
  exercise    = jismoniy mashq
  a start     = boshlanish
  Good luck!  = Omad!
  an aunt     = xola, amma
  at all      = umuman

items.uz: Birinchidan, ko'proq meva va sabzavot yeyishingiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ Rasm yonida ✓ — demak MASLAHAT BERILADI:
'SHOULD'.

⚠ 'should' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda:
  'should EAT'    ✓
  'should to eat' ✗
  'should eats'   ✗

⚠ 'fruit' va 'vegetables': 'fruit'
sanalmaydi, 'vegetableS' — ko'plikda.

⚠ Rasm yonida ✗ — demak INKOR:
'SHOULDN'T'.

'should not' → 'shouldn't'.

⚠ Inkorda ham fe'l ASOSIY shaklda:
'shouldn't EAT' ✓

items.sentence: 3  ... or ......................................... . They aren't healthy at all.  (RASM: gamburger ✗)
items.uz: ... yoki gamburger. Ular umuman foydali emas.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'or' dan keyin fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI —
faqat ot yoziladi.

⚠ KO'PLIKDA: 'pizza or hamburgerS' —
umumiy ma'noda ovqat nomlari ko'plikda.

⚠ 'not ... AT ALL' = UMUMAN emas.

items.uz: Nonushtaga donli nonushta ... iste'mol qilgan yaxshiroq.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ ✓ belgisi, lekin bu safar 'should' EMAS —
kitob 'It's ...' deb boshlagan.

⚠ QOLIP: 'It's BETTER TO + fe'l'
= ... qilgan yaxshiroq.

Bu — maslahat berishning 2-usuli.

⚠ 'and' dan keyin faqat OT.

⚠ 'milk' SANALMAYDI — artiklsiz.

⚠ 'FOR breakfast' — ovqat mahali oldidan
'for'.

⚠ ✗ belgisi → 'SHOULDN'T'.

⚠ Bu safar fe'l 'drink' — rasmda IChIMLIK.

⚠ 'cola' sanalmaydi — artiklsiz.

items.sentence: 7  ... or ......................................... because they are full of sugar.  (RASM: sariq gazlangan ichimlik ✗)
items.uz: ... yoki limonad, chunki ularda shakar juda ko'p.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'lemonade' — Britaniyada GAZLANGAN
shirin ichimlik (rasmda sariq gazli suv).

⚠ AmE 'lemonade' — limon sharbati
(gazsiz)! Ikki mamlakatda boshqacha.

'full of sugar' = shakarga to'la.

⚠⚠ MASLAHATNING 4-USULI:
'WHY DON'T YOU + fe'l?'
= ... qilsangiz-chi?

⚠ Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda:
  'Why don't you DRINK' ✓
  'Why don't you to drink' ✗

⚠ 'instead' gap OXIRIDA turadi.

items.answer: isn't a good idea to eat chocolates
items.uz: Yana, shokolad ... yeyish yaxshi fikr emas.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠⚠ MASLAHATNING 3-USULI:
'It ISN'T A GOOD IDEA TO + fe'l'
= ... qilish yaxshi fikr emas.

⚠ 4-bandda 'It's BETTER TO' edi (✓ uchun),
bu yerda ✗ — shuning uchun INKOR shakl.

⚠ 'an idea' SANALADI — 'a good idea'.

⚠ KO'PLIKDA: 'chocolates or cakeS'.

⚠ 'to get fat' = semirmoq.
'get' + sifat = holatga o'tmoq:
  get fat  — semirmoq
  get tired — charchamoq
  get old  — qarimoq

⚠ 'will only get fat' — 'only' fe'ldan
oldin.

⚠ ✓ belgisi → 'SHOULD'.

⚠⚠ 'DO exercise' — 'MAKE' EMAS!
  'do exercise'   ✓
  'make exercise' ✗

⚠ 'exercise' bu ma'noda SANALMAYDI:
'more exercise' ('more exercises' ✗).

items.sentence: 12  Why don't you leave the car at home and ......................................... to work?  (RASM: piyoda ketayotgan odam ✓)
items.uz: Mashinani uyda qoldirib, ishga piyoda borsangiz-chi?

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'Why don't you leave ... and WALK' —
'and' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda
(chunki 'don't you' ikkalasiga tegishli).

⚠ 'walk TO work' — 'to' bor;
lekin 'go home' da 'to' YO'Q.

'to leave' = qoldirmoq; ketmoq.
